title: Tell me, Mary, how to woo thee

anchor.text: Tell me, Mary, how to woo thee
anchor.prefix: of Doctor Fell) or his carbuncly nose with the pimples on it and his sandy moustache a bit white under his nose. Poor father! With all his faults she loved him still when he sang
anchor.suffix: or My love and cottage near Rochelle and they had stewed cockles and lettuce with Lazenby's salad dressing for supper and when he sang The moon hath raised with Mr Dignam that die
anchor.canonical_text: Tell me, Mary, how to woo thee
